name: codecalc
description: Code & logic calculator for AI agents: 31 languages, symbolic math, SMT/logic solving, Big-O.
long_description: First launch needs network access: it resolves and installs `codecalc[full]` (~120 MB, including the symbolic-math and parsing extras) from PyPI into an isolated environment. Offline at that point, it fails with a dependency-resolution error rather than starting in a degraded mode. After that first launch everything is cached locally, and nothing is re-downloaded unless the version changes. Windows on ARM64 is not supported: one of codecalc's own dependencies (cryptography) ships no wheel for that platform.

runtime_path.title: Runtime PATH
runtime_path.description: PATH executed code resolves language runtimes on (CODECALC_RUNTIME_PATH). Claude Desktop launches the server with a stripped environment, so an inherited PATH can miss a toolchain manager's shims (mise, nvm, rustup, ...) entirely and most languages silently become unavailable. Leave blank to fall back to the server's own PATH.
